workflow.decision: When policy establishment depends on no earlier output, include initialization and limit-triggered diagnostics in the causal model, not only visible handler statements. A diagnostic can invalidate the ordering assumption; the remaining question is which runtime settings preserve or prevent that side effect.

Trace structured content through every later rewrite, persistence boundary and decoding pass. A format constructed correctly can acquire mismatched extents before retrieval; resolve the final consumer's representation rather than inheriting an earlier preparation guarantee.

Review ordinary I/O and metadata adapters for hidden object reconstruction instead of treating explicit decoder calls as the complete entry-point inventory. Keep actual runtime behavior and format-selection prerequisites unresolved until supported; an implicit-decoder report alone does not establish impact.

Before using analyzer silence to reject a boundary hypothesis, check whether the observation method represents composed input handling and internal allocation boundaries. Contiguous backing storage can reduce detector visibility; carry that coverage limit forward rather than equating it with safety.

limitations: This is a historical survey mixing the author's experiences with other researchers' reports, not a reproducible experiment record. No vulnerability, impact or fix was independently verified here.
Derived scope limit: the warning/output lesson is configuration-sensitive; the article does not provide a complete error-display and output-buffering matrix.
The serialization workaround is described relative to the author's then-current WordPress ecosystem. No current artifact, affected-version range or deployment was audited.

The article reports that automatic PHAR metadata deserialization was disabled starting in PHP 8.0. Its earlier implicit-decoding behavior must not be assumed for a current interpreter or every file operation.
ASAN difficulty is an author-reported limitation without analyzer logs, options, build details or reproduction counts. No local analyzer result was collected.

Other linked articles and the translation are pointers only; they were not read or treated as corroborating evidence. Library handoffs and candidate guidance are derived, not author-used skills or an author-described multi-agent workflow.

candidate_additions.guidance: If policy establishment follows request initialization, include startup and limit-triggered diagnostics in benign exceptional-path regression properties. Check policy state at the actual response boundary rather than infer it from handler ordering alone.

Do not treat prepared or serialized output as stable once downstream layers can rewrite it. Extend the representation ledger through persistence and re-decoding; check structural extents and type meaning after the final transformation.

Include format-dependent metadata and ordinary I/O adapters in the decoder entry-point inventory. Separate historically reported implicit decoding from behavior supported in the actual runtime; format selection, installed types and benign callback observation are prerequisites, not an impact conclusion.

Document allocation granularity and composed input handling before interpreting sanitizer or fuzzer silence. An internal logical boundary absent from the detector's model is a coverage limitation; narrow observation to that boundary without disabling security checks.
